# Pheasant Farm — example staking plots

Demonstrates StakeDXF after Convert DWG layer selection:

- **Points:** `PHEASANT_FARM-STAKE-ROCK_PROBE_2026-07-16.txt` (40 rock probes)
- **Linework:** clipped selected layers from `PHEASANT_FARM_trimble_access.dxf` (`PHEASANT_FARM_staking_layers_clip.dxf`)
- Generated by `mobile/stakedxf/tool/generate_pheasant_farm_plots.dart`

| File | What it shows | Layers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `01_rock_probe_curb_storm.pdf` | Rock probe grid — large X, number + elevation, curb + storm layers | P-CURB, P-U-STM, P-SW |
| `02_utilities_with_table.pdf` | Filled triangle — full labels + point table, STM/SAN/WAT utilities | P-U-STM, P-U-SAN, P-U-WAT, P-(FUTURE)-U-STM |
| `03_lotlines_and_cl.pdf` | Circle markers — number + description, lot lines + centerline | RES_SURVEY$0$P-LOTLINE, RES_SURVEY$0$E-LOTLINE, RES_SURVEY$0$P-CL, RES_SURVEY$0$E-ROW |
| `04_selected_layers_overview.pdf` | Large dots — no labels, all clipped staking layers (layer-select demo) | 12 selected |
| `05_points_only_grade_check.pdf` | Dot markers — number + elevation, points only (no linework) | — |
| `06_full_sheet_selected_linework.pdf` | Control-note style — table + curb/sidewalk/storm/lotline selection | 5 selected |
